page: Google Cloud Platform c2-standard-8 is a compute-optimized virtual machine powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon processor operating at a base frequency of 3.1 GHz. The instance is configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 4 physical cores using multithreading with 2 threads per core. It features 32.0 GB of system RAM, maintaining an even 4.0 GB per core allocation. The hardware cache hierarchy provides 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 24 MB of shared L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX, AVX-512F, and AVX-512 VNNI, alongside hardware encryption via AES.

The c2-standard-8 configuration includes no bundled local storage, requiring attached persistent disks or external network storage for file systems. Hardware acceleration is absent, with zero GPUs included in the profile. In addition, no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default. The platform architecture prioritizes continuous CPU compute capacity rather than integrated storage density or accelerated graphical processing.

Benchmark testing places this instance in the middle tier for most compute and memory operations. It achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 1317.0 and a multi-core score of 4970.0, paired with a PassMark CPU score of 9362.45. Memory bandwidth reaches 52.6 GB/sec for large-block uncached reads and 39.71 GB/sec for writes. The server handles 8.05 million Redis SET operations per second and achieves a static web serving throughput of 7.07 GB/sec. However, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression registers in the bottom 25% of tested systems at 30.85 GB/sec.

Given its dedicated core allocation and balanced ratio of compute to memory, the instance delivers predictable execution efficiency without shared-core CPU contention. Tradeoffs include reliance on networked storage for all persistence and below-average performance in specialized multi-threaded decompression workloads. It is appropriate for CI/CD compilation, web application serving, batch data processing, and in-memory key-value databases.
description: Google Cloud Platform c2-standard-8 is a compute-optimized instance powered by a 3.1 GHz Intel Xeon processor on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores with multithreading, paired with 32 GB of system memory to maintain 4 GB per vCPU. Hardware features include 24 MB of L3 cache and instruction support for AVX-512 and AVX-512 VNNI. The instance contains zero local disk storage and lacks integrated GPUs, necessitating network storage for data persistence. Across benchmarks, the server demonstrates consistent middle-tier performance, logging a PassMark CPU score of 9362.45, Geekbench multi-core score of 4970.0, and Redis throughput of 8.05 million operations per second. However, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression falls into the lower 25th percentile. The c2-standard-8 is configured for CPU-bound tasks, CI/CD compilation pipelines, high-concurrency web serving, and distributed in-memory caching.
